name: Kawasaki Ninja H2 / H2 SX
engine: 998 cc supercharged liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's supercharged four. Most of the work here is on the dealer side, and many bikes are in a cam chain tensioner recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Many 2015-2023 H2 models are in recall 22V912 (cam chain tensioner), and some 2020-2021 bikes in 21V593 (oil pressure relief valve).
A-002.reason: Both can stall the engine while riding. The fixes are free.

H: The supercharger and its service are dealer work for most owners. Follow the manual's intervals.

recalls.what: Cam chain tensioner plunger can lock, which can stall the engine.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the cam chain tensioner free.

recalls.what: Oil pressure relief valve problem can cause a loss of oil pressure and an engine stall.
